title: Binary Boarding
description: Decode boarding passes as binary numbers to find seat IDs.
writeup:
## Approach

The boarding pass is binary space partitioning — but it's really just a 10-bit binary number in disguise.

## Part 1

Replace F/L with 0 and B/R with 1, then parse as binary. The result is the seat ID (row * 8 + column). Find the maximum.

## Part 2

Find the one missing seat ID in the contiguous range. Sort all IDs and look for the gap, or scan from min to max for the missing value.
